 ET Now
 Rishi Basu
 Good evening, and welcome to our third quarter results. Over to you, Salil.
 Salil Parekh
 Thank you, Rishi. Our large deal momentum continued through the quarter. The new revenue growth
guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency. Our operating margin
guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
 Rishi Basu
 Thank you, Salil. The first question is from Mansee Dave from ET Now.
